lines.text: @maya_front sits in her first car, grips the wheel with both hands, takes a breath, and turns the key.
Interior, low angle up at her.

writes.note: I added one short VO line over the shot and left your words as they were.

reply.rationale: The shot already shows the first-car moment, so the VO is one short line that adds feeling without repeating the action. It fits inside the shot's length and the 15 s target.
